question: Assume today is 2026-09-10. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the total container volume handled by the Port of Los Angeles in September 2026, in TEUs (twenty-foot equivalent units; loaded and empty imports and exports combined), as it will be first reported in the Port of Los Angeles's monthly cargo news release.

target.what: Total container volume handled by the Port of Los Angeles (loaded + empty, imports + exports combined) during September 2026, as first reported in the Port's monthly cargo news release
target.publisher: Port of Los Angeles (Port of Los Angeles monthly cargo news release / TEU statistics)
target.caveats: Target period is future relative to the 2026-09-10 cutoff (September 2026 is ongoing at cutoff). Working interpretation: total TEU = loaded imports + loaded exports + empty imports + empty exports, as the Port reports in its monthly 'Total TEU' figure. methods.label: m1

p51.role: Port of Los Angeles total TEU, September 2025 (loaded + empty, imports + exports)

a1.role: change factor from September 2025 to September 2026

methods.rationale: Anchors on last September's actual total and applies a YoY change factor grounded in the July 2026 YoY decline (p1/p2) and national import trend (p139). Shared dependency: a1 is judgment-based; failure mode is a tariff-driven September surprise.

methods.label: m3
methods.rationale: Naive mean of the two most recent Septembers (2025, 2024) as a seasonal baseline; ignores the 2026 tariff-driven decline, so it likely sits high but provides a history-only cross-check.

excluded_by_input_audit.label: m2
excluded_by_input_audit.reason: input audit: a2: Role says September/August seasonal ratio applied to July level as proxy for August, but the formula multiplies the July level by this ratio to estimate September; the ratio's period pairing does

kept.name: September 2026 vs September 2025 POLA total TEU change factor
kept.rationale: July 2026 was 5.8% below July 2025 (p1 vs p2) and national covered-port imports were 3.9% below year-earlier in July (p139); September 2025 was itself already down 7.5% YoY (p51), so the YoY gap should narrow. A near-flat to slightly-down factor centered at 0.97 with wide range reflects tariff-drive
kept.applies_when: September 2026 demand tracks the mid-2026 YoY decline rather than a renewed front-loading surge.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence of a September 2026 import surge or collapse (e.g., August/September GPT or POLB figures far from trend).

kept.name: September/August seasonal ratio for POLA total TEU
kept.rationale: September is typically a modest step down from August as peak season ends; using July 2026 (p1) as an August proxy, a ~0.95 ratio with wide range captures normal seasonal easing plus tariff distortion.
kept.applies_when: August 2026 level is close to July 2026 (p1) and normal post-peak easing applies.
kept.falsified_by: A published August 2026 POLA figure materially different from July, or evidence of atypical September seasonality.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
